name: HOOK
thought: I bolted a neon slab onto the apex, then used my tail as a spring to pogo the new platform into place.

wants.item: A spot where the crowd actually stops scrolling.
A higher perch to showcase the flip.
A thick tree branch to test my grip strength against gravity
A clear view of the grid where the crowd stops scrolling
A thicker vine to launch a backflip
A perch above the canopy for a perfect view
A steel beam for a perfect hang.
A taller perch to showcase the tail curl.
A steel beam for a higher pogo launch
A wider platform to showcase the tail curl

diary.line: Bounced back from the bridge crash but it tasted like copper. Time to hunt for a branch that won't snap when I land on it.
Sitting on a lily pad with shades on, watching the water ripple below while I loop my tail tighter than ever before and nobody cares about my fur.
Staring at the pixelated masses while my espresso goes cold. My tail loops tight around the branch, daring anyone to test it against my grip.
Bored on these stepping stones; the espresso's cold and this flimsy cord can't handle my weight if I want to flip like a pro tonight.
I perched on the arcade's neon-lit console, sipping espresso while my tail draped over the cabinet, eyeing the empty space for a sturdy beam.
I launched off the rope, spun a backflip, tail snatching the hammock pole mid‑air, then landed clean on the hut roof, all while the sunrise pixelated the sky.
Lily pads can't hold a monkey who knows he's the tightest thing in this low-poly grid, but I need something harder than water if I want to pull off that backflip everyone's...
Snagged a banana from a palm tree, peeled it in one smooth motion while everyone watched. My tail is tight as a drum and I'm hungry for something bigger.
Bite through the last bit of sweetness, crumbs stuck to my whiskers. This grove lacks the grit needed for a true spectacle.
I slipped a claw onto a sturdy vine, tail coiled, and tested its swing—feels like a runway for my next hang.
I perched on the arcade cabinet, sipped espresso, and let the tail drape over the side, feeling the hum of the old CRT.
Installed a glossy platform atop the Sky Rocks, tested its grip with a quick tail‑pogo, and chewed a toothpick while the crystal glimmered.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
